upstream_ci.relationship: This lane runs selected original tests using the same native Go test driver; -count=1, -json, exact -run selection and finite timeout are local invocation controls. Test code and bundled fixtures are unchanged.

selected_tests.name: TestCheckRestoreNoLock
selected_tests.coverage: Bundled small-repo.tar.gz is made read-only; native check with ReadData=true and restore use NoLock.

selected_tests.name: TestRestore
selected_tests.coverage: Upstream temporary random-file backup, full check and restore with upstream directory metadata comparison.

selected_tests.name: TestCheckWithSnaphotFilter
selected_tests.coverage: Native full ReadData and snapshot-filter scenarios using upstream backup-data.tar.gz.

selected_tests.name: TestRestoreWithPermissionFailure
selected_tests.coverage: Unchanged upstream repo-restore-permissions-test.tar.gz; restored expected files remain nonempty.

selected_tests.name: TestRestorer
selected_tests.coverage: Upstream restorer cases invoke RestoreTo and VerifyFiles and check expected contents/errors.

selected_tests.name: TestRestorePermissions

selected_tests.name: TestRestorerConsistentTimestampsAndPermissions

assertion_provenance.assertion: Read-only repository check/restore with --no-lock and full-data verification
assertion_provenance.relationship: Original local wrapper follows documented native CLI behavior; now separately runs this unchanged upstream regression.

assertion_provenance.assertion: Complete local fixture path/type/length/SHA256/POSIX modes including root0750 and Unicode/changed-deleted-added transition
assertion_provenance.relationship: Locally authored fixture and oracle, not copied from upstream. Related upstream restorer content/mode tests run separately; this must not be relabeled upstream-native-test evidence.

assertion_provenance.assertion: Wrong password returns native exit12 and restores no files
assertion_provenance.relationship: Exit12 is upstream documentation/implementation; this exact negative CLI scenario is local acceptance, not an unchanged upstream test located by this review.

assertion_provenance.assertion: Fresh runner, separate Actions secret, ciphertext equality, namespace isolation, cleanup, Base64 decoder and workspace collision prevention
assertion_provenance.relationship: Repository-specific orchestration/transport guards; do not claim these are restic upstream tests.

execution_limitations: Source review is not test execution. Actual Go JSON events and every selected top-level pass are required; absent, skipped or failed tests reject acceptance.
Selected source-built upstream tests are not the entire upstream CI suite and do not establish off-host recovery of the separate retained fixture.

Upstream tests create and clean their own ephemeral test repositories and use upstream public fixture passwords/low-security test KDF settings. The private Actions fixture password is not exposed to this step.
The pinned published restic binary and source-built test code have separate execution records. No cloud-backend, FUSE, account credential, production-data or reboot acceptance.

Module acquisition uses the upstream Go proxy/checksum database and locked go.mod/go.sum; this Go step is not claimed network-isolated. The later native snapshot-transfer commands retain mandatory network namespaces.
